title: Ledger intermediate document
description: Tool-independent intermediate representation of this fleet's bespoke markdown ledgers (TODO.md / TODO.archive.md / ROADMAP.md / ROADMAP.archive.md / REVIEW_ME.md). Produced by tracker/ledger-map.py, consumed by the Plane and Vikunja adapters (id:90f2). Prose contract: tracker/SCHEMA.md. TODO id:2bb1.

schema_version.description: Contract-surface version marker. This repo has NO repo-wide version (CLAUDE.md Versioning); this marker exists because a stale adapter reading a changed document fails SILENTLY. Bump on any change to required keys or enums; adapters must refuse a version they do not know.

unmapped.description: Loud-lossy report: every ledger construct this mapping does not carry. Never empty-by-silence — id:4347 no-silent-swallow.

unmapped_counts.description: construct -> count, so a consumer can assert the lossy surface is shrinking without reading every entry.

repo.description: Repo name — the first half of the composite (repo, id) key.

verdict.description: classify-repo.sh's per-repo verdict (relay-poolable / needs-feedback / design-drained / idle / blocked). Filled by id:c17d; null from this mapper, which does not run the classifier.

uid.description: '<repo>/<key>' — the composite key. <key> is the 4-hex id for a tracked item, or a '~'-prefixed content hash for an id-less one. 4-hex ids are PER-REPO and never fleet-unique (TODO id:c3f6 caveat 1), so uid — never id — is the primary key.

id.description: The item's own anchored <!-- id:XXXX --> token, or null for an id-less line.

todo_status.description: The TODO.md/TODO.archive.md view's checkbox state. NEVER collapsed with roadmap_status.

roadmap_status.description: The ROADMAP.md/ROADMAP.archive.md view's checkbox state. NEVER collapsed with todo_status.

review_status.description: The REVIEW_ME.md view's box state — a third view, not folded into either ledger view.

drift.description: true iff both ledger views are present and disagree. This is the single-id-two-views drift orphan-scan.sh --cross-ledger reports; the board is the first place it is visible.

derived_status.description: DERIVED for adapters only, never authoritative. An OPEN view always beats a DONE view, so a drifting item is never rendered done.

fields.description: The Acceptance / Tests / Done-check / Context sub-bullets.

owner_accepted.description: @owner-accepted:YYYY-MM-DD — owner-only; an importer never writes it, it only carries what the ledger says.

target_uid.description: null until fleet-level resolution. A routed token resolving to >=2 repos is a class-B collision and is FATAL.
